Build a personal profile page — the page every developer has. It proves you can lay out a full semantic document. ### Sections to include 1. **Header** — your name as `

` 2. **About** — a paragraph about yourself 3. **Skills** — an unordered list 4. **Social links** — links to LinkedIn / GitHub 5. **Footer** — copyright line ### Layout skeleton ```html

Your Name

Student · Aspiring Software Engineer

About Me

...

Skills

  • ...

Find Me

LinkedIn GitHub
© 2026 Your Name
``` ### Pro tips - One `

` only - Use `
` for each chunk with its own `

` - Give images an `alt` if you include one

codeSnippets.output: A section titled 'Skills' with a two-item list.

exercise.instruction: Create your own profile page. Must include: a <header> with your name as an <h1>, a <main> with at least two <section> blocks (each with an <h2>), an unordered <ul> of at least 2 skills, and a <footer>.
hints: Hint 2: Inside <main>, add at least two <section> blocks, each with its own <h2>.
Hint 3: Put skills in a <ul> and end with <footer>.</footer>
